hints.title: Maintain Valid Subarray Boundaries
hints.text: Maintain the leftmost boundary index such that the difference between maximum and minimum does not exceed k.

hints.title: Prefix Sum DP Transitions
hints.text: Each valid partition ending at index right can start at any valid left index; use running sums of previous answers.

hints.title: Monotonic Boundary Updates
hints.text: As the right pointer advances, the minimum valid left pointer moves rightward monotonically.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def countPartitions(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        pref = [0] * (n + 2)
        pref[1] = 1
        
        max_dq = deque()
        min_dq = deque()
        left = 0
        
        for right in range(n):
            while max_dq and nums[max_dq[-1]] <= nums[right]:
                max_dq.pop()
            max_dq.append(right)
            
            while min_dq and nums[min_dq[-1]] >= nums[right]:
                min_dq.pop()
            min_dq.append(right)
            
            while max_dq and min_dq and (nums[max_dq[0]] - nums[min_dq[0]]) > k:
                if max_dq[0] == left:
                    max_dq.popleft()
                if min_dq[0] == left:
                    min_dq.popleft()
                left += 1
                
            # valid partition starts from left to right
            # sum dp[left ... right] = pref[right + 1] - pref[left]
            ways = (pref[right + 1] - pref[left]) % MOD
            dp[right + 1] = ways
            pref[right + 2] = (pref[right + 1] + ways) % MOD
            
        return dp[n]
```

complexity.notes: Amortized linear time with sliding window monotonic queues and prefix sum array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all partition intervals results in O(N^2) or exponential states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining DP prefix sums computes range transitions in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine monotonic sliding window boundaries with prefix sum dynamic programming.
